action.command:
cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 30 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://docs.openhands.dev/openhands/usage/settings/llm-settings" | python3 -c "
import sys,re,html
s=sys.stdin.read()
s=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',s,flags=re.S); s=re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>','',s,flags=re.S)
s=re.sub(r'<(br|/p|/div|/li|/h[1-6]|/tr|/td)>','\n',s)
t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',s))
t=re.sub(r'[ \t]+',' ',t); t=re.sub(r'\n\s*\n+','\n',t)
i=t.lower().find('advanced')
print(t[:1200] if i<0 else t[max(0,i-900):i+2200])
"
